response.original_title: {Add Fellow Traveler} Can You Add Another Passenger to a Explora Journeys  Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Explora Journeys cruise, you must call customer service or your travel advisor directly, as passenger additions cannot be processed online or via the mobile app. How to Request an Addition Call Direct Support: If you booked directly, call the Explora Experience Centre at. (Alternative contact numbers also used: Contact Your Travel Advisor: If you booked through a travel agency, your agent must handle the modification and coordinate the request on your behalf. Adding a guest depends on whether your current stateroom has extra beds (such as Pullman beds or sofa beds) and whether the ship has remaining safety and lifeboat capacity Required Information: Have the new passenger's full legal name, date of birth, passport details, and payment information ready when you call. +1-866-259-1002 (US)
